graded_report.note: declared non-spiking classes; a coarse class list with its evidence, not physiology measured here
graded_report.excluded: lobula columnar visual_projection neurons (they spike; von Reyn 2017)
graded_report.resolved: cell_type + superclass from neurons.feather (never row order)

encoder.model: drifting sinusoidal grating on R1-R6 only, retinotopic by cartridge

protocol.f1: 2/N * sum V(t_k) exp(-i 2 pi f t_k), t_k = end of each step
